private_seed_values: ten fixed evaluator-held values supplied out-of-band; never included in model prompts or release artifacts
development_note: Values 0–19 are burned historical fixtures. v0.2 tuning, certification, regression, and public pools are disjoint and are not private evaluator values.
policy: Every model receives the same public or private seed set. Private values are revealed only to the evaluator after submission; they are not a security claim against source disclosure.
